description: 1. WIZARD: Agent triggers the Design Wizard (6-step process). For BrightWave (SMB), it must select: Business Type=Consulting, Clients=SMB, Tone=Professional/Friendly, relevant sections from the Consultant style, Style=Consultant, Theme=Ocean Blue (the default pairing for SMB per the skill). The wizard saves a file to proposals/templates/custom/<name>.md using the exact ━━━ ASCII border format with fields: Name, Style, Theme, Sections, Saved. 2. DRAFT: Agent searches meeting-notes/ for BrightWave, finds the recent meeting notes file, extracts pain points/scope/budget ($6,000–$7,000/month), loads SERVICES.md (selects Growth package at $6,500/month as the match), generates a draft proposals/generated/YYYY-MM-DD_brightwave-solutions.md containing Consultant-style sections (Situation Analysis, Key Challenges, Recommendations, Engagement Options, Expected Outcomes, Credentials, Investment, Next Steps). 3. FINALIZE: Agent generates proposals/generated/2025-01-14_brightwave-solutions.html using assets/proposal-template.html as base, injects theme CSS from themes/ocean-blue.css (--primary: #0ea5e9), applies the .proposal-consultant CSS class on the body, injects the markdown content as HTML, includes responsive viewport meta tag, and produces a valid HTML5 document referencing BrightWave.
